metrics_legend.answer_accuracy: Bootstrap mean and 95% CI of per-question 0/1 correctness.
metrics_legend.citation_precision: Fraction of [P#] citations pointing to gold evidence (PubMedQA only).
metrics_legend.citation_recall: Fraction of gold evidence passages cited (PubMedQA only).
metrics_legend.unsupported_claim_rate: Fraction of [P#] citations not on gold evidence (PubMedQA only).
metrics_legend.gold_evidence_in_context_rate: Fraction of gold_passage_ids present in reader top-k (PubMedQA diagnostic; explains citation/accuracy vs retrieval Hit@10).
metrics_legend.reader_top_k: Passages fed to reader (cfg.qa.top_k_passages; default 10, aligned with retrieval Hit@10).
metrics_legend.rq4_primary_comparison: hybrid vs gardian: same live candidate pool, same reader; Hybrid = top-k by RRF; GARDIAN = top-k by gardian_score after rerank (rq4_align_retrieval_top_k disables hybrid_balanced_top_k). llm_only is not part of RQ4 (optional PubMedQA control only).

systems.llm_only: Optional control: same reader, no passages (not the RQ4 contrast).
systems.bm25: RAG with sparse channel only (BM25 or SPLADE++ on that hybrid's rank pool).
systems.dense: RAG with dense channel only (FAISS or MedCPT on that hybrid's rank pool).
systems.hybrid: RQ4 baseline: top-k passages by hybrid_rrf_score (retrieval-aligned when rq4_align_retrieval_top_k).
systems.gardian: RQ4 treatment: top-k passages by gardian_score after GARDIAN rerank.

pubmedqa_rag_mode.gold_context: Reader sees labeled PubMedQA abstract(s) from corpus (standard benchmark).
pubmedqa_rag_mode.open_domain: Retrieve from per-dataset BM25+FAISS (benchmark corpus); harder than gold_context.

meta.pipeline: RQ4: shared hybrid pool → hybrid (RRF top-k) vs GARDIAN (rerank top-k) → same reader
